title: Lab - File permissions and searching for files
description: Audit permissions and hunt down files by their properties.
scenario: Audit permissions and hunt down files by their properties. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Octal
tasks.instructions: Make /opt/lab/bin/run executable by owner and group only, readable by nobody else, in one chmod.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Recent and large
tasks.instructions: Find files under /var larger than 10M modified in the last 2 days.
